```{ojs prelims}
//| output: false

Plot = import("https://esm.sh/@observablehq/plot@0.6.17")

task_info = ({
    "hf": "Hearts & Flowers",
   "sds": "Same & Different",
    "mg": "Memory",
  "math": "Math",
"matrix": "Pattern Matching",
  "mrot": "Shape Rotation",
  "trog": "Sentence Understanding",
 "vocab": "Vocabulary",
   "tom": "Stories",
    "pa": "Language Sounds",
   "sre": "Sentence Reading",
   "swr": "Word Reading",
})

stats_coded = stats
  .map(d => ({...d, Task: task_info[d.task_code] }))
  .sort((a, b) => {
    const keysOrder = Object.keys(task_info);
    return keysOrder.indexOf(a.task_code) - keysOrder.indexOf(b.task_code);
  })
```

::: {.column-screen-inset}

```{ojs}
// shared options for all plots
stats_opts = ({
         style: { fontFamily: "var(--sans-serif)", fontSize: 12, overflow: "visible" },
         width: 700,
    marginLeft: 130,
  marginBottom: 40,
     insetLeft: 10,
             y: { grid: true, label: null },
             x: { line: true },
             r: { label: "N", range: [1, 4] },
         color: { scheme: "Spectral" }
})

tip_vars = ({ "Dataset": "dataset" })

// reliability
Plot.plot({
  ...stats_opts,
  x: { label: "Empirical reliability", line: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(stats_coded, {
      x: "empirical_rxx",
      y: "Task",
      stroke: "Task",
      r: "n_scores",
      sort: { y: "x", color: "x", reverse: true },
      tip: true,
      channels: tip_vars
    })
]
})

// age correlation
Plot.plot({
  ...stats_opts,
  x: { label: "Age correlation", line: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(stats_coded, {
      x: "cor_score_age",
      y: "Task",
      stroke: "Task",
      r: "n_scores",
      sort: { y: "x", color: "x", reverse: true },
      tip: true,
      channels: tip_vars
    })
]
})

// test-retest correlation
Plot.plot({
  ...stats_opts,
  x: { label: "Test-retest correlation", line: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(stats_coded, {
      x: "trt_1_2",
      y: "Task",
      stroke: "Task",
      r: "n_1_2",
      sort: { y: "x", color: "x", reverse: true },
      tip: true,
      channels: tip_vars
    })
]
})
```

```{ojs redivis}
redivis = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/redivis/+esm")

// get stats table from workflow
async function getStats() {
  console.log('getting stats')
  const rows = await redivis
    .user('mikabr')
    .workflow('levante_data_latest_psychometrics:xhxj')
    .table('task_x_dataset_combined:h9gb')
    .toRowsArray()
  console.log('got stats')
  return rows;
}

stats = await getStats()
```
